summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the sequence formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, which returns True only when is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: tests and Black were not executed, per instructions. Nothing committed. Title text is written unmodified, so titles containing BEL or ESC can corrupt the sequence.
